meta_doc_type_001.evidence: AGREEMENT Between THE SCHOOL BOARD OF PINELLAS COUNTY, FLORIDA And THE PINELLAS CLASSROOM TEACHERS ASSOCIATION, INCORPORATED

meta_effective_dates_002.evidence: This Agreement shall become effective on the 1st day of July, 2015, and shall continue in full force aand effect until the 30th day of June, 2018

meta_bargaining_unit_003.evidence: The term “teachers” includes all full-time certified instructional personnel including but not limited to: itinerant personnel, media specialist, school psychologist

meta_document_scope_004.evidence: This Agreement constitutes the official position of the Board for the term of said Agreement. The Superintendent and the Union Association will carry out the commitments contained herein and give them full force and effect.
